name: Goblin
summary: Goblins are diminutive, cunning humanoids originating from the Isle of Kezan, renowned across Azeroth for their relentless pursuit of profit, explosive engineering, and aggressive trade cartels. While most maintain a stance of strict neutrality to maximize commerce between the Alliance and Horde, mercenary and cutthroat outfits like the Venture Company and Steamwheedle Cartel leave an indelible mark on every corner of the world.

sections.title: Cartels of Kezan
sections.body: Goblins hail from the Isle of Kezan in the South Seas, where their society long ago divided into competing economic syndicates known as cartels. Rather than building kingdoms or armies of their own, goblin leaders channeled their ambitions into cutthroat mercantilism, volatile engineering, and industrial ventures that now reach every corner of the world.

sections.title: Mercenaries and Mercantilism
sections.body: During the Second War, Trade Prince Steamwheedle allied his cartel with Orgrim Doomhammer's Horde, supplying maps, siege craft, and fleet-building expertise in exchange for Stormwind's captured plunder. Following the Horde's eventual defeat, the cartels learned that open allegiance cost them lucrative markets. In the modern era, the major cartels claim official neutrality, maintaining bustling trade havens like Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale and Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert. Here, Alliance and Horde travelers cross paths without blades drawn—so long as port bruisers keep the peace.

sections.title: Hired Hands and Industry
sections.body: A goblin's primary loyalty belongs to gold, and many operate outside the neutral cartels as hired specialists or ruthless corporate barons. The Venture Company pursues unchecked deforestation and resource stripping across continents, heedless of local populations. Elsewhere, skilled artificers sell their talents directly to criminal enterprises: deep inside the Deadmines, goblin engineers like Sneed, Gilnid, and Captain Greenskin oversee smelters and shipwrights constructing a massive ironclad juggernaut for the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Are goblins aligned with the Alliance or the Horde?
faq.answer: Neither. The primary trade syndicates, including the Steamwheedle Cartel, adhere to strict neutrality to trade freely with both sides. Individual goblins and private enterprises happily contract out their services to the Horde, Alliance, or third parties like the Defias Brotherhood for the right price.

faq.q: Why are goblin inventions so prone to exploding?
aliases: why do goblin machines blow up
faq.answer: Goblin engineering prizes raw power, haste, cheap production, and high explosive yields over structural safety, so their devices deliver spectacular results and spectacular explosions in roughly equal measure.

The Steamwheedle Cartel is the most influential mercantile cartel operating on the mainland. They manage vital neutral trading ports and cross-continental transit hubs, including Booty Bay in southern Stranglethorn and Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert.

The Venture Company is a ruthless goblin-run industrial conglomerate notorious for aggressive deforestation, strip-mining, and oil extraction. Unlike the Steamwheedle Cartel, they operate with little regard for local law or environmental balance, often clashing violently with native populations.

faq.q: Why are there goblins working with the Defias in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood possessed abundant plundered coin and raw ore from the Moonbrook mines, allowing them to hire top goblin specialists. Craftsmen like Sneed, Gilnid, and Captain Greenskin were contracted to oversee heavy smelting and build Edwin VanCleef's ironclad juggernaut.
Goblins hail from the tropical Isle of Kezan in the South Seas. It was there that their great trading cartels first rose, building an empire of commerce and industrial smog.

angles.text: Goblin engineering prioritizes extreme explosive force, offensive gadgetry, and high-risk mechanical contraptions, standing in sharp contrast to the precise, defensive designs favored by gnomes.
Mining fuels the goblin cartels' industry and trade, and they remain fiercely protective of valuable mineral claims across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
Alliance authorities remain deeply suspicious of goblin neutrality, remembering well their mercenary service providing warships and sappers to the Old Horde during the Second War.
While Thrall's Horde utilizes goblin mechanics and trades with neutral hubs, memory remains fresh of the mercenary contracts forged between Orgrim Doomhammer and Trade Prince Steamwheedle.
